_comment: Venue / local-ticketing sites whose event pages embed schema.org Event JSON-LD. Each entry: listing page(s) crawled for links matching link_pattern; every matched page's Event block imports. url_template turns a captured fragment (e.g. a Wix {"slug":...}) into the page URL. Category = mapsee frontend key. Optional "venue" {name, address, city, region, postal_code, lat, lon} FILLS a missing/partial event location for single-venue sites (every show is at the same place) - supply address+city+region and the sync geocodes it, or lat+lon to skip geocoding. Optional "skip_title" is a case-insensitive regex matched against the event NAME, for the non-events a venue posts to its own calendar (closure and private-hire notices). A "listing" need not be an HTML page: link_pattern is a regex over whatever the URL returns, so a site's own event sitemap is often the complete source where a calendar page renders only its first screenful.
